Database generation, migration, data copy/plan/verify and audit scripts are excluded from this first slice because their names do not establish a local-only effect boundary.

The two declared Workers test tasks select only request-body.test.ts and cart-price-display.test.ts through the original test:unit script. On 2026-10-01, native tests passed 5 request-body cases and 22 cart-price cases, the original Workers unit/runtime noEmit typecheck passed, and the Kefu production build passed with Node 22.23.3/npm 10.9.9. Independent frozen npm ci --ignore-scripts installs preserved both component locks; the local-only Drizzle postinstall patch was not needed or executed. The first typecheck exceeded a 120-second validation deadline; the unchanged command passed with a 300-second deadline. The initial Kefu build hit a sandbox ancestor-directory read denial; the identical approved retry passed.

The same scoped tasks also passed through CinaCLI: Workers check and both fixed-file tests, plus Kefu build, all returned structured success/exit 0; their three plan invocations returned exit 0. The 27 unit cases do not establish runtime acceptance. The remaining Workers suites, Kefu tests and Admin/PC/Supplier/UniApp components are still pending validation.
PC build includes its auth and image unit test scripts. UniApp H5, Weixin and app builds are separate local artifact capabilities; no publication or deployment task is declared.
